description: A collection of Claude Code plugins and skills, grouped by category. Index model: this marketplace only points to each item's original repository (whole plugin repos, or the exact skill folders inside them); installs fetch from upstream — no third-party code is copied into this repo.
name: bag-of-skills

plugins.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents, covering the full software development lifecycle from spec to ship. By Addy Osmani (Google Chrome). 115k+ stars, MIT.
plugins.name: agent-skills
superpowers
plugins.description: Agent working rules: plan first, write a test, then build, then verify its own work before saying done. 306k stars. Heavy for single-step writing/design tasks.

plugins.name: mattpocock-skills
plugins.description: 38 engineering skills from Matt Pocock, including ones that interrogate the plan before the agent writes code. 305k stars.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Pushes the agent to pick the simplest fix and write as little code as possible. 178k stars.

plugins.name: egm
plugins.description: Elephant-Goldfish Model (EGM): review rules that check a design or spec at two levels, the big picture and the fine detail. 7.2k stars.

plugins.name: rea
plugins.description: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything): works out how any app actually works, from what it shows on screen down to the code underneath.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: ECC: a large pack of skills, memory, and security checks in one bundle. 291k stars. Note: it is a big bundle, so expect overlap if you already run a full agent setup.

plugins.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
plugins.description: A single rule file for cleaner code, distilled from Andrej Karpathy's notes. 225k stars. The repo carries no clear license.

plugins.name: understand-anything
plugins.description: Turns code into a clickable map that explains itself. 88k stars. Duplicates Graphify's job.

plugins.name: gstack
plugins.description: 23 tools acting as CEO, designer, engineering manager, and QA; strongest at browsing the live web. 137k stars. Wrapped from the root SKILL.md.

plugins.name: bmad
plugins.description: BMAD Method: a shadow agent team (analyst, PM, architect, developer) carrying an idea to a build, as 30+ skills. 54k stars.

plugins.name: cli-anything
plugins.description: Agent-native CLI harnesses for 40+ apps (Blender, GIMP, Audacity, Draw.io, Obsidian, ComfyUI, Godot, QGIS) so an agent can drive desktop software from the terminal. 57k stars. The app itself must be installed on the same machine.

plugins.name: playwright-cli
plugins.description: Browser automation from the terminal: drive pages, test flows, take screenshots. 14k stars, Apache-2.0. Needs the browser download.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: The skills.sh registry skill: teaches the agent to search, install, and update SKILL.md packages via 'npx skills find/add'. 36k stars. Only knows SKILL.md packages.

plugins.name: hermes-jev-skills
plugins.description: 13 skills for the Hermes agent that put Jev in charge of small decisions: model routing, skill selection, memory, compaction. Built for Hermes, not Claude Code.

plugins.name: claude-x-jev
plugins.description: A Claude Code skill that hands yes/no, label, and score decisions to Jev (TypeSafe's decision model on OpenRouter) so the expensive model only reads what needs judgment. Needs paid OpenRouter credit.
Official Cloudflare skills for building, testing, and deploying applications on the Cloudflare platform (Workers, Agents SDK, Durable Objects, Wrangler). 3.3k+ stars, Apache-2.0.
plugins.name: cloudflare
claude-mem
plugins.description: Remembers past sessions and injects the useful parts into new ones. 103k stars. Can collide with a setup that already has its own memory system.

BLA (Blind LLM Agents): hardens build artifacts (JS bundles, Electron, WASM, Python, binaries) with decoy code and canary credentials so AI reverse-engineering agents burn tokens on shadows while the app runs identically for real users. 5.3k+ stars, MIT. Very young project; treat claims as unverified.
plugins.name: bla
strix
plugins.description: Companion skills for Strix, the autonomous AI penetration-testing agent: API security testing, OWASP Top 10, CI scanning, vulnerability fixing. 72k stars, Apache-2.0. The skills wrap only; Strix itself is a separate app needing Docker and a paid LLM key. NEVER point it at systems you do not own.

Garden Skills by ConardLi: six skills in one wrap — beautiful-article (source material into a polished single-file HTML article), gpt-image-2 (image generation/editing with 80+ templates), kb-retriever (local knowledge-base QA), motion-showreel (code-rendered motion videos), web-design-engineer (polished browser visual artifacts), web-video-presentation (articles/scripts into click-driven video-like web decks). 14.9k+ stars, MIT.
plugins.name: garden-skills

plugins.description: Anatomy: from a one-line prompt, the agent draws complex machines/systems as interactive isometric illustrations (SVG/WebGL) that can be rotated, exploded, and run. 26.7k+ stars, MIT. Went viral in Oct 2026; commits have been quiet since, and a single figure can take a long agent run.
plugins.name: anatomy
ui-ux-pro-max
plugins.description: Gives the agent a designer's eye: layout, colour, type, spacing. 141k stars.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: A design language for the agent so everything looks like one product. 90k stars.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Taste: art direction for the agent — works from reference images and checks the result in a real browser. 103k stars, MIT.

plugins.name: taste-teardown
plugins.description: Website Taste Teardown: pulls the concrete design tokens (colour, type, spacing) plus the reasoning out of a website you like. 430 stars. No license file in the repo.

plugins.name: hallmark
plugins.description: 16 anti-AI-look rules, 48 themes, plus scripts that check a page at 8 screen widths and screenshot it. 39k stars, MIT. Upstream forbids silent redesigns — only use on an existing design when explicitly asked.

plugins.name: antislop
plugins.description: Anti-Slop: four rule sets that strip AI slop from UI, code comments, layout, and copied text. 7.3k stars, MIT. Guards style only; gives no design direction.

plugins.name: emil-kowalski-skills
plugins.description: 18 design and motion skills from Emil Kowalski: build an animation, animation performance and vocabulary, Apple-style design, find/improve/review animation opportunities, pick a UI library, break UI on purpose, prototype variants, native-feeling mobile, plus Swift and Expo variants. 50k stars, MIT.

plugins.name: diagram-design
plugins.description: Editorial-style diagrams in HTML, 45 types, clean without clutter. 61k stars.

plugins.name: logo-design
plugins.description: Professional logo and brand-mark process, from brief to presentation. Marks only, not web layouts. 4.8k stars, MIT.

plugins.name: baoyu-design
plugins.description: Builds design artifacts as self-contained HTML: mockups, wireframes, prototypes, landing pages, decks. 4.5k stars, MIT. HTML artifacts only. Wrapped from the archive folder — the upstream layout is non-standard.

plugins.name: designlang
plugins.description: designlang (design-extract): points a headless browser at any URL and writes out 17+ files — DTCG tokens, Tailwind config, shadcn theme, Figma variables, motion tokens, hover/focus states, WCAG contrast scores, responsive layout at 4 breakpoints. 4.4k stars, MIT. Needs Node plus a browser download.

plugins.name: ux-ui-agent-skills
plugins.description: Design system and production UI standards: components, tokens, accessibility, WCAG gates, plus a small CLI. 3k stars, MIT. Heavy for a one-page landing.

plugins.name: oil-ui
plugins.description: Explores design directions, builds a multi-style comparison page in one screen, then refines from real screenshots. 2.4k stars, MIT. Upstream docs are Mandarin and its auto-update script is disabled.

plugins.name: brand-identity
plugins.description: Full brand identity set from one brief: logo, typography, palette. 176 stars, MIT. Overlaps Logo Design and Design Skills.

plugins.name: designskills
plugins.description: Five skills covering brand, brand strategy, creative direction, design principles, and web design. 18 stars, MIT. Overlaps the other brand skills; pick one source, not both.

plugins.name: gsap-skills
plugins.description: Eight official skills that teach an agent correct GSAP animation: core API, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, React/Vue/Svelte, performance. 17k stars, MIT. Overkill for small hover/click effects.

plugins.name: transitions-dev
plugins.description: 43+ crafted UI transitions (modal, dropdown, badge, icon swap, panel reveal, page slide) with a skill per transition plus an agent that can audit and fix motion in a repo. 5.8k stars, custom license: commercial use allowed, reselling the library itself is not.

HyperFrames by HeyGen: write HTML, render video. Compositions, GSAP, and runtime adapters for programmatic video. 82k+ stars, Apache-2.0. Also hosts the reverse-any-video skill (the reverse feature itself is a paid Pro feature).
plugins.name: hyperframes

plugins.description: Turn the project in the current folder into a polished, shareable 15-25 second launch video, rendered with HyperFrames. 21k+ stars, MIT.
plugins.name: brag

plugins.description: Official Remotion skills: best practices, captions, creation, docs, interactivity, licensing, maps, markup, multimedia, and rendering. 6.8k+ stars. Note the Remotion framework itself uses a special license (not pure open source).
plugins.name: remotion-skills

plugins.description: Hypit: paste a viral video (TikTok/Reel/Short) and the agent dissects its shots, pacing, dialogue, word-timed captions, B-roll, and effects, then rebuilds it as an editable, re-runnable workflow (swap host/hook/product/language for ~100 variants). 29k+ stars. Generation models are BYOK or paid (HypiHub).
plugins.name: hypit

plugins.description: video-use by the browser-use team: the agent edits raw footage conversationally. The LLM reads word-level transcripts (ElevenLabs Scribe) plus an EDL instead of watching video, then renders via ffmpeg with a self-evaluation loop: cut filler words and dead air, color grade, burn subtitles, animated overlays. ~31k stars, MIT. Needs an ElevenLabs API key and local ffmpeg. Includes the manim-video skill.
plugins.name: video-use

plugins.description: Motionmaxxing: an agent skill that turns stiff AI video into professional motion design, with easing timing measured frame-by-frame from 53 pro film moments; renders locally with HTML/GSAP + ffmpeg. 1.5k+ stars, Apache-2.0. Early release (Oct 2026).
plugins.name: motionmaxxing

plugins.description: Motion graphics skills for Claude Code (from Charlie Hills' curation): animated charts, Apple-style launch films, brand intake, launch videos, loop covers, milestone reveals, model showdowns, motion briefs/effects/prompts. 644 stars, MIT. Exports via HyperFrames.
plugins.name: motion-graphics-skills

plugins.description: Claude Motion: a motion-design toolkit for coding agents on top of Remotion — numeric motion rules (easing, stagger, reading holds), a contact-sheet self-review loop, and a built-in sound engine. Skills: motion-design, review-loop, sound-design, web-sims. 944 stars, MIT. Very early (Sep 2026, no releases yet).
plugins.name: claude-motion
openmontage
plugins.description: OpenMontage: a video studio inside the agent — script, cut, voice, render — as a large skill pack (90+ skills: video generation/editing, TTS, subtitles, animation systems). 72k stars, AGPL-3.0. Needs FFmpeg. Repo moved from calesthio/OpenMontage to OpenMontageInc/OpenMontage.

plugins.name: last30days
plugins.description: Researches what people said in the last 30 days across Reddit, X, YouTube, and the web, then summarises with sources. 65k stars, MIT.

plugins.name: agent-reach
plugins.description: Lets the agent read and search X, Reddit, YouTube, and GitHub without paying API fees. 105k stars, MIT. Public sources only; sites can block them. Wrapped from the bundled skill folder.

OpenSEO: an open-source, pay-as-you-go Semrush/Ahrefs alternative packaged as agent skills — site audit, keyword research, backlink analysis, rank tracking, plus the ai-visibility-audit skill (how your brand shows up in ChatGPT/Gemini/Google AI answers), local-seo, and competitor-analysis skills. 27k+ stars, MIT. Data typically comes from inexpensive paid APIs (DataForSEO/SerpApi).
plugins.name: open-seo

plugins.description: open-seo-mcp-skills: a free MCP server plus SEO/GEO skills for Claude — keyword research, rank tracking, and audits. 9.2k+ stars, MIT.
plugins.name: open-seo-mcp-skills
marketing-skills
plugins.description: Sales material skills: copywriting, SEO, conversion, analytics. 56k stars. Best once a product exists to sell.

plugins.name: anthropic-skills
plugins.description: Official Anthropic skills pack: docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx, webapp-testing (Playwright), frontend-design, brand guidelines, canvas design, MCP builder, skill creator, and more. 184k stars. Wrapped from the skills folder.

plugins.name: ppt-master
plugins.description: Turns a document or topic into a real editable PowerPoint, not slide images. 69k stars.

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.description: Short plain answers so tokens stop burning. 115k stars, Apache-2.0. Not ideal when you need a concept explained in depth.

plugins.name: token-saver
plugins.description: Thins large tool output, skips repeated commands, gates scheduled LLM sessions on real state changes, and measures daily token use. MIT. Does not compress instruction files or memory.

plugins.name: career-ops
plugins.description: Scores each job ad 1-5 against a CV, then tailors the CV and cover letter for the ones worth applying to. 77k stars, MIT. Handles personal data — treat with care.

plugins.name: i-have-adhd
plugins.description: Puts the answer first so the point is never buried mid-paragraph. 59k stars, MIT.

plugins.name: open-steps
plugins.description: Eight skills that make an agent talk to non-technical people: one-screen reports, followable steps, checking another session's claims. 1.2k stars, MIT. The rules are in English.

plugins.name: headroom
plugins.description: Shrinks logs and tool output before the agent reads them (proxy + compression). 78k stars, Apache-2.0. Wraps the upstream headroom-skill plugin.

11 Claude skills for day trading US stocks: chart scanner, news, entry, exit, replay simulation, risk, and alerts. Paper trading by default. 6.8k+ stars, MIT. A research/education tool, not a profit guarantee.
plugins.name: day-trader-skill

plugins.description: Awesome Novel: a skill for writing novels with any LLM — project state detection, new-project initialization, and a structured fiction workflow handed to a novel agent. AGPL-3.0.
plugins.name: awesome-novel
humanizer
plugins.description: Strips AI writing tells: em dashes, the not-X-but-Y pattern, triple lists. 60k stars, MIT. For academic manuscripts use naskah-id instead.

plugins.name: naskah-id
plugins.description: Writes and edits Indonesian academic manuscripts: spelling, standard words, effective sentences, anti-fabricated citations. MIT.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: Rewrites dense text into plain language and shows a revision view of what changed. 727 stars, MIT. Different rule set from academic writing.
